full_judgment:
9. The defendant Mokshed Ali Khan contested the claims of the Plaintiff in the suit contended inter alia that the Plaintiff has no right to file the suit and that the suit is barred by limitation. 

 13. The learned Subordinate Judge framed the issues regarding maintainability, court fee, suit valuation and limitation and decided those issues in favour of the Plaintiff. As regard the issue of claims of the Plaintiff the learned Subordinate Judge decreed the suit in part in preliminary from with cost.
